name: Princess the Unicorn — show intro

shots.shot: Aerial sweep at sunrise over Rainbow Forest — golden light, two soft rainbows arcing through the mist above the canopy, the sparkling stream winding below. No characters.
Princess gallops TOWARD the camera down a flower-lined path, mane streaming, laughing with joy, petals swirling around her.
Princess leaps over the sparkling stream in one joyful arc while Pip the bluebird swoops alongside her, both facing camera as they land.
Princess spins and dances in the glowing mushroom glade, Moss the little dragon bouncing beside her, fireflies rising like confetti.
Princess runs toward camera and LEAPS up and to the left, springing out of frame with her tail trailing sparkles — the background brightens toward white as she jumps.
ENDING (composited, not generated): her leap carries into pure white, dissolving into THE LOGO exactly as drawn; on the final note the logo's Princess blinks (logo-blink.png frame swap) and holds.

consistency: every character shot carries the cast plate as reference
